Hi all —

For pilot stipends applied to customer invoices we generally issue a credit memo (not a contra journal) so the customer has a document to attach to their AP workflow. That keeps the customer-facing ledger clean and is what our revenue recognition team prefers for short-term promotional allowances.

Requirements / next steps from our side:
- Priya: please confirm the total credit amount to put on the memo (USD). I have a draft credit_memo_draft.pdf I can populate once amount confirmed.
- Finance metadata: we will post to GL 7010 (Cost of Revenue - Trials & Promotions) and clear against AR as Credit Memo type 'Promotional Allowance'. Include reference: INV-2026-0773 and DEAL-LL-2026-0417.
- Tax: No VAT treated on promo credit memo (this was covered under the SOW clause). Finance will include a note on the memo about tax treatment.
- Audit CSV: Priya, please attach the export for 2026-06-15 — 2026-07-31 (token-level summary by route); we need requestor, timestamp, and token_count columns. Laura, once we have CSV we will keep a copy in the audit folder and attach a redacted version for the customer.

I propose the flow: Priya provides amount + CSV -> I populate credit memo PDF and internal journal supporting worksheet -> Neha performs the revenue classification check and signs off -> I send final PDF + redacted CSV to Sara and upload supporting docs to the finance audit bucket.
